slides.text: In this movement , the Muslim community of erstwhile British India united and agitated against the colonialists at the national level. This movement got further strength when Mahatma Gandhi combined the non-cooperation movement against colonialism with the Khilafat movement. Hindus and Muslims unitedly opposed the British Raj under the supervision of the Indian National Congress.

slides.text: Police Brutality, Riots And Loot The Tamora, Mahasamund Jungle Satyagraha of 1930 was a non-violent and symbolic Satyagraha, but it was a huge tumult was there all over the region. S ome parallel incidents took place, which were carried out by the British government in an attempt to break, intimidate and weaken the movement. The British had instilled so much hatred among the sycophants and policemen who took advantage of the government for the people who spoke against the government and that a police constable of Indian origin was beating the people of his own country with hatred and brutality.
